title: File:Follow the Red Rock Road (3018055130).jpg
desc:
As it continues its southward odyssey, Opportunity’s handlers are using images taken from orbit to help map a route that avoids sand traps—and includes as much solid bedrock as possible. This new view of the dune sea appears in approximately natural color, as processed by James Canvin.
